## 현재 자산배분

```{ojs}
allocRaw = FileAttachment("data/allocation.csv").csv()
assetCols = (allocRaw.columns ?? []).filter(c => c !== "날짜")
latest = allocRaw.length ? [...allocRaw].sort((a, b) => b["날짜"].localeCompare(a["날짜"]))[0] : null
latestRows = latest ? assetCols.map(k => ({자산군: k, 비중: +latest[k]})).filter(d => !isNaN(d.비중)) : []
```

```{ojs}
latest
  ? html`<p>기준일 <strong>${latest["날짜"]}</strong> · 비중(%)만 기록합니다.</p>
         ${Plot.plot({
           x: {domain: [0, 100], label: "비중 (%)", grid: true},
           y: {label: null, domain: assetCols},
           color: {legend: false},
           width: 420, marginLeft: 80, marginRight: 40, height: 34 * assetCols.length + 50,
           marks: [
             Plot.barX(latestRows, {x: "비중", y: "자산군", fill: "자산군"}),
             Plot.text(latestRows, {x: "비중", y: "자산군", text: d => `${d.비중}%`, dx: 20}),
             Plot.ruleX([0])
           ]})}`
  : html`<p class="empty-note">아직 기록된 자산배분이 없습니다. data/allocation.csv에 한 줄을 추가하세요.</p>`
```
:::

::: {}
## 공부 진행 현황

```{ojs}
progress = FileAttachment("books/progress.json").json()
html`${progress.books.map(b => {
  const done = b.total_chapters ? b.summarized / b.total_chapters * 100 : null;
  const mine = b.summarized ? b.my_thoughts / b.summarized * 100 : 0;
  return html`<div class="progress-row">
    <div class="label"><a href="${b.href}">${b.title}</a>
      <span>요약 ${b.summarized}${b.total_chapters ? ` / ${b.total_chapters}` : ""}장</span></div>
    ${done !== null ? html`<div class="progress-bar-wrap"><div class="progress-bar-fill" style="width:${done}%"></div></div>` : ""}
    <div class="label" style="margin-top:.4rem"><span>내 생각 작성</span><span>${b.my_thoughts} / ${b.summarized}장</span></div>
    <div class="progress-bar-wrap"><div class="progress-bar-fill" style="width:${mine}%"></div></div>
  </div>`;
})}`
```
:::
:::
